newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Walker Corp gets nod for link-up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Walker Corp gets nod for link-up.

text.p: Shareholders in Walker Corp Ltd on Tuesday backed a proposal for the company to form a partnership with Ruly Holdings Pty Ltd for its A$132.5 million development of the Broadway Shopping Centre in Sydney.

Under the partnership Walker Corp and Ruly will each contribute A$20 million of equity to the redevelopment of the site formerly occupied by the Grace Bros department store in Sydney's inner west. Shareholder approval was needed to secure the partnership as Ruly is controlled by Walker Corp founder and managing director Lang Walker.
"We were pleased to get the thing to bed," Walker Corp general manager corporate development Geoff Davey told Reuters.

Walker Corp had initially planned to develop the site with an independent partner, but said earlier this month that it had been unable to attract a partner on suitable terms due to falling sentiment in the retail sector.
Work has already started on the 38,000 square metre initial stage, which will include large retailers, specialty shops and a cinema, Davey said.
Walker Corp shares ended down one cent at A$0.90.
